The gate as a checklist, not a judgement: every AC discharged, every CI gate green. rfc-check, req-registry --check, doc-drift, req-status, control-plane-check, spec-discipline, anti-pattern-gate. Read every exit code DIRECTLY — 'cmd | tail; echo $?' reports tail's status, an error that reached a PR description here and needed a public correction.

```day-atom
{"_version":2,"in":["certification-result"],"out":["gate-result"],"next":["residual-trust"],"revisits":["implement"]}
```
